title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium Arena on 1982-12-26

ai_review.summary: High‑energy late‑'82 show with a smoking China>Rider and standout Far From Me, captured on a classic SBD that sounds a bit tinny but still enjoyable.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised for its relentless energy – the China>Rider transition is called "smoking," Far From Me shines with Brent’s lead work, and even Cassidy gets rave reactions. The recording is a classic soundboard source; while some listeners note crispness, others describe it as tinny with low levels and a drum‑heavy mix, yet it remains listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show very highly for performance and energy; recording quality receives mixed but generally acceptable comments, leading to an overall strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as a classic SBD with high‑quality moments, but several reviewers note a tinny, low‑level mix where drums are prominent and other instruments sound muddled.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A non‑standard setlist that introduced early versions of Touch of Grey and Throwing Stones, with a high‑energy flow throughout and a powerful second set.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Articulate work on Eyes; "Jerry goes off" during the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mentioned debuting his new six‑string Modulus bass guitar.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mix emphasizes drumstick hits, making drums stand out while other instruments sound muffled.
